description: This file defines serializers and copiers for various byte-related data structures and a BitArray in the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It includes codecs for byte arrays, Memory<byte>, ReadOnlyMemory<byte>, ArraySegment<byte>, and a specialized PooledBuffer, as well as a serializer and copier for BitArray. The file uses attributes for registration and contains methods for reading, writing, and copying data, illustrating serialization logic for these types within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: BitArrayCodec
classes.description: Serializer for BitArray objects, supporting read and write operations with special handling for references and wire types.

classes.name: BitArrayCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for BitArray, creating a deep copy or reusing existing copies from the context.

classes.name: ByteArrayCodec
classes.description: Serializer for byte[] arrays, handling reading from and writing to serialization streams.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMemoryOfByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for ReadOnlyMemory<byte>, supporting reading and writing byte sequences.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMemoryOfByteCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for ReadOnlyMemory<byte>, creating a copy as a new array.

classes.name: ArraySegmentOfByteCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for ArraySegment<byte>, creating a new array from the segment.

classes.name: MemoryOfByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for Memory<byte>, handling reading and writing of memory buffers.

classes.name: PooledBufferCodec
classes.description: Serializer for PooledBuffer objects, writing segments and reading into a new buffer.

classes.name: PooledBufferCopier
classes.description: Shallow copier for PooledBuffer, assuming it is immutable.

methods.name: GetSetArray
methods.description: Retrieves the internal array of a BitArray, using unsafe access or reflection depending on the .NET version.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a serialized value for various types, handling references and length-prefixed data.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates deep copies of byte[] and Memory<byte> types, or returns the input directly for PooledBuffer.
